description: This file defines a JavaScript module that provides a React hook for managing CRUD and analytics operations on 'links' stored in a Supabase database, optionally routing through an Express backend. It includes functions for listing, creating, updating, deleting links, incrementing click counts, and fetching analytics, with support for both direct database access and backend API integration.

methods.name: useLinksService()
methods.description: Main hook exposing CRUD, click tracking, and analytics functions for link management.

methods.name: waitForSession(timeoutMs = 5000)
methods.description: Waits for the authentication session to be loaded, with a timeout.

methods.name: getAuthHeaders()
methods.description: Fetches the authorization headers containing the Bearer token for authenticated requests.

methods.name: qs(params)
methods.description: Constructs URL query string from parameters.

methods.name: listByUser
methods.description: Retrieves list of links for the current user with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new link for the current user.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing link owned by the current user.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a link owned by the current user.

methods.name: incrementClicks
methods.description: Increments the click count for a specific link and returns updated info.

methods.name: analytics
methods.description: Fetches total link count and total clicks for the current user.
